senses.gloss:
mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
1 Mountainous, mountaineer, &c.
2 Stony, rocky.
m. (-लः)
A mountain.
n. (-लं)
1 Bitumen.
2 Storax.
3 A sort of collyrium: see रसाञ्जन.
f. (-ली)
A concise interpretation of a grammatical aphorism.
E.
शिला a rock, a stone, अण् aff.

n. (कं)
Storax or Benzoin.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-कः)
The brow or slope of a mountain.
E.
शैल, and कटक flank.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced in or on mountains, rocks, &c.
n. (-जं)
1 A fragrant resinous substance, (Storax or Benzoin.)
2 Bitumen.
E.
शैल a mountain, and ज produced.

m. (-नः)
A mountaineer.
E.
शैल, and जन a person.

m. (-न्वा)
ŚIVA.
E.
शैल a mountain, and धन्वन् a bow.

m. (-रः)
KṚṢṆA.
E.
शैल a mountain, and धर who upholds.

n. (-सः)
Storax, Benzoin.
E.
शैल a rock, and निर्य्यास exudation.

m. (-तिः)
The Himālaya.
E.
शैल, and पति master.

f. (-त्तिः)
A stone-cutter's chisel or axe, an instrument for dividing or cutting stones.
E.
शैल a mountain, भिद to divide, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Rocky.
E.
शैल, and मयट् aff.

n. (-न्ध्रं)
A cavern, a cave.
E.
शैल, and रन्ध्र a hole.

n. (-रं)
The crest or peak of a mountain.
E.
शैल, and शिखर a peak.

n. (-रं)
The ocean.
E.
शैल a rock, and शिविर a camp or palace.

n. (-ङ्गं)
The peak of a mountain.
E.
शैल, and शृङ्ग a horn.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Hard, firm, as a rock.
E.
शैल, and सार essence.

n. (-ग्रं)
The peak of a mountain.
E.
शैल a mountain, and अग्र top.

m. (-टः)
1 A lion.
2 A mountaineer, a savage, a barbarian.
3 An attendant on an idol.
4 Crystal.
E.
शैल a mountain, and अट to go, aff. अच्.

m. (-ली)
An actor, a dancer.
E.
शिलालिन् a Muni, said to have been the author of the principles of acting, &c., अण् aff., शैलाल his institutes, and इनि aff. of profession or practice.

m. (-क्यः)
An impostor, a pretended devotee.

m. (-षः)
An actor, a dancer, a tumbler, &c.
2 A rogue, a cheat.
3 The master of the band, or one who beats time.
4 The Bel tree, (Ægle marmelos.)
E.
शिलूष one of the early teachers of the arts of acting, &c., अण् aff. of descent.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
1 Produced in the mountains, &c., mountainous, mountaineer^1.
2 Mountain-like.
n. (-यं)
1 A fragrant resin, (Storax or Benzoin.)
2 A vegetable perfume, commonly Murā.
3 Rock salt.
m. (-यः)
A bee.
f. (-यी)
A name of PĀRVATĪ.
E.
शिला a mountain, ढक् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-ल्यं)
The skirts of a mountain or low land at its base.
E.
शैल, and उपशल्य neighbouring space.

nf. (-ल्यं-ली)
Hardness, stoniness.
E.
शिला a stone, a rock, ष्यञ् aff.
